customer: Hello, I put a lot of miles on my station wagon commuting, and last spring it sat in some high water during a storm that came up past the door sills. I'm thinking about selling it to Northwind Auto. Is that something I need to mention, and would it affect whether you'd buy it?
agent: Thank you for checking before you request an offer. Yes, please let us know about it: if water ever got into the cabin or the engine, you should tell us when you request an offer. Per our article "Flood-damaged cars," cars with flood damage, or with a flood brand on the title, count as branded, and we don't buy them (see Salvage and rebuilt titles).
